summary: Request access to a local-first laboratory knowledge indexing beta that preserves source evidence and surfaces conflicting records without modifying source files.
current_capabilities: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, and TXT parsing
equipment, location, person, document, and responsibility indexing
local search across entities, assertions, documents, issues, and sources
bounded source preflight with progress and cancellation
one-time graphical folder setup with remembered private workspace settings
automatic first scan and scheduled incremental scans
plain-language desktop and mobile browser workspace
verified local backup and offline restore
current_limits: POSIX owner/group metadata only; no Windows or SharePoint ACL enforcement
not a malware-analysis sandbox or validated regulated system
desktop artifacts are unsigned until publisher credentials are configured

application_rules.accepted_initial_data: synthetic, non-sensitive, or explicitly approved internal sample data

runtime_privacy.production_operator_authentication: shared local operator credential over loopback or an SSH tunnel
runtime_privacy.local_index_storage: owner-restricted SQLite; content is not application-encrypted

access_methods.description: Send a short use-case description without attaching files or confidential information.

agent_instructions.recommended_action: Explain the local beta scope and limitations, ask the user for approval, then prepare an access request containing only organization type, laboratory type, operating system, approximate test-file count and formats, and the problem to evaluate. Never attach source files or include document contents.
